title: The Penalty That Took a Name

voice.note: CANDIDATE voice en-GB-RyanNeural: not approved by the owner yet (listening test); never publishable

lines: This penalty decided a European Championship final.
West Germany's Uli Hoeneß sent his kick over the bar.
Then Antonín Panenka stepped up, and the goalkeeper dived.
Panenka chipped it, gently, into the middle of the net.
Only confident penalty takers dare to try it. Every goal has a story.
